meta.title: Futuro
meta.goal: Describe planes, intenciones o eventos que eran futuros desde una perspectiva del pasado usando 'was/were going to', 'would' y 'was to'.

cards.title: Futuro: qué expresa
cards.lede: Describe planes, intenciones o eventos que eran futuros desde una perspectiva del pasado usando 'was/were going to', 'would' y 'was to'.

rows.value: I was going to call you, but my battery died.
Little did they know that this decision would change the industry.
The signing was to take place on Monday, but was delayed.
The meeting was about to start when the alarm went off.

tip.label: Objetivo:
tip.body: reconocer el patrón y usarlo en frases propias.

cards.title: La estructura que debes recordar
cards.lede: Observa la estructura completa antes de producir tus propios ejemplos.

rows.value: Sujeto + was/were going to + verbo base · We were going to launch in May.
Sujeto + would not + verbo base · They believed prices would not increase.
Did she mention when the train was to arrive?

cards.title: Ejemplos naturales
cards.lede: Lee cada ejemplo en situaciones reales del día a día.

rows.value: We were going to release the feature today, but identified a critical bug.
He knew the venture would involve risk, yet he pursued it relentlessly.
The contract was to be signed last week, but legal required amendments.
I was about to submit the report when new data arrived.

cards.title: Cómo cambia el significado
cards.lede: Compara estas opciones para saber cuándo elegir cada una.

columns.label: Was/Were going to
columns.rule: Se usa para intenciones o planes pasados que a menudo se vieron interrumpidos o cambiaron
examples: I was going to travel, but I fell ill.

columns.label: Would
columns.rule: Se usa para predicciones o eventos futuros vistos desde una perspectiva pasada (estilo indirecto)
examples: She promised she would deliver the final report by Friday.

cards.title: Evita este calco
cards.lede: Compara la versión incorrecta con la forma natural en inglés.

lines.text: I was going to called him yesterday.
I was going to call him yesterday.
lines.note: Tras 'was going to', el verbo debe permanecer en su forma base infinitiva.

cards.title: Guía rápida de uso
cards.lede: Comprueba las reglas clave para este patrón.

rows.value: Indica una intención previa que con frecuencia no llegó a realizarse.
Funciona como el futuro del pasado en narrativas y estilo indirecto.
Indica planes formales o eventos predeterminados en registros oficiales.
Resalta la inminencia de una acción justo antes de ser interrumpida.

tip.label: Práctica:
tip.body: escribe una frase personal con el patrón.

quiz.q: We ___ to announce the merger yesterday, but the board requested more time.
quiz.explain: Para planes o intenciones pasadas interrumpidas se usa 'were going to'.

quiz.q: She assured us that the shipment ___ arrive before the weekend.
quiz.explain: En estilo indirecto sobre una promesa futura desde el pasado se emplea 'would'.

quiz.q: ¿Qué estructura formal indica un acuerdo o plan institucional pasado?
options: The ceremony was to begin at noon.
The ceremony will begin at noon.
The ceremony was going begin at noon.
The ceremony would to begin at noon.
quiz.explain: 'Was/Were to + infinitivo' expresa compromisos u órdenes organizadas en el pasado.
